title: FAA Ground Stop Linked to Copper Wire Replacement Work
excerpt: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that the nationwide FAA ground stop resulted from routine maintenance involving copper wire replacement.
body_html:
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that a recent nationwide ground stop ordered by the Federal Aviation Administration was connected to routine maintenance work.

During a press conference, Duffy explained that the incident stemmed from efforts to replace outdated copper wire with a new fiber optic line at a remote FAA facility. He clarified that this activity was considered routine maintenance rather than a major modernization project.
